text:
You quit at the exact moment you would have won.

Darby's uncle drilled for gold. Three feet from the vein, he quit. Too tired. Hands raw. Broken bit.

A junk dealer bought the rig. Found the vein three feet down. Made millions.

He read about it in the newspaper.

You are the same. Tired right now. Three weeks from the win. Three days from the answer.

And you are walking away.

Quit now, stay broke. Dig three more, own the vein.
caption:
Most men fail when self improvement is one step away. The difference is usually three more feet of discipline.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #persistence #mindset #success #selfimprovement
